## Checklist

- [ ] Title is a conventional commit ending with the issue key, e.g. `feat: … (#5)`
- [ ] Branch is `<type>/<issue>-<slug>`
- [ ] Tests cover the change; `uv run pytest` passes, coverage included
- [ ] Test data is fictional (no real names, emails, account ids or project keys)
- [ ] Command or option changes are documented (`--help` text and README)
